CA.rationale: A processing-origin ('command_estimate'/'feedback_through') is explicitly linked to the candidate red coordinate set.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinate set), its presentation (coordinate listing/orientation), and separate origin/status metadata are all explicitly present and bound for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Processing condition ('command_estimate'/'feedback_through') is explicitly associated with the candidate content's presentation.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly identify color-labeled contents as coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata (copied_prior_record, history_estimate, command_estimate) are given separately from the color/location content, distinguishing identity from status/organization.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are presented (coordinate listings) and the grid orientation.
